Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

PPO, proof of own age I excess payment.  
Where the pensioner and his / her spouse do not have a joint bank account, the spouse of the deceased pensioner, will be required to provide death certificate along with Form 10 copy of PPO, if available and proof of age I date of birth. - GID (1), Rule .79 of CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021.
